paragraphs: Amgen Inc. is an American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. The company is ranked 18th on the list of largest biomedical companies by revenue. The name "AMGen" is a portmanteau of the company's original name, Applied Molecular Genetics.

The company's major products are Prolia and XGEVA (denosumab) to treat osteoporosis and bone diseases ($6.6 billion in total 2025 revenues), Repatha (evolocumab) to treat hyperlipidemia ($3.0 billion in 2025 revenues), Otezla (apremilast) to treat psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis ($2.3 billion in 2025 revenues), Enbrel (etanercept) to treat autoimmune diseases ($2.2 billion in 2025 revenues), Evenity (romosozumab) to treat osteoporosis ($2.1 billion in 2025 revenues), Tepezza (teprotumumab) to treat Graves' ophthalmopathy ($1.9 billion in 2025 revenues), Blincyto (blinatumomab) to treat acute lymphoblastic leukemia ($1.6 billion in 2025 revenues), Nplate (romiplostim) to regulate platelet production ($1.5 billion in 2025 revenues), Tezspire (tezepelumab) to treat asthma ($1.5 billion in 2025 revenues), Kyprolis (carfilzomib) to treat cancer ($1.4 billion in 2025 revenues), Aranesp (darbepoetin alfa) to stimulate erythropoiesis ($1.4 billion in 2025 revenues), Krystexxa (pegloticase) to treat gout ($1.3 billion in 2025 revenues), and Vectibix (panitumumab), a monoclonal antibody ($1.2 billion in 2025 revenues).
Amgen has 17 clinical programs underway in Phase III, eight in Phase II, and 19 in Phase I. Its pipeline includes MariTide, an anti-obesity medication administered once per month by injection.
The company receives approximately 80% of its revenues from sales to the three large U.S. drug wholesalers: McKesson Corporation, Cencora, and Cardinal Health.
The company is ranked 134th on the Fortune 500 and 202nd on the Forbes Global 2000.
In 2020, the company was added to the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA).

people.name: Robert A. Bradway
people.title: Chairman of the Board, Chief Executive Officer and President
people.bio: Bradway has been President since 2010, Chief Executive Officer since 2012, and Chairman since 2013. He previously served as Amgen's Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer and was a Managing Director at Morgan Stanley.
people.quote: Mr. Bradway has been the Company's President since 2010 and Chief Executive Officer since 2012.

people.name: James E. Bradner
people.title: Executive Vice President, Research and Development
people.bio: Bradner became Executive Vice President, Research and Development, in 2023 and also served as Chief Scientific Officer from 2023 to 2024. He previously served as President of the Novartis Institutes for BioMedical Research from 2016 to 2022.
people.quote: Dr. James E. Bradner, age 53, became Executive Vice President, Research and Development, in 2023

people.name: Murdo Gordon
people.title: Executive Vice President, Global Commercial Operations
people.bio: Gordon became Executive Vice President, Global Commercial Operations, in 2018. Before joining Amgen, he served as Chief Commercial Officer at Bristol-Myers Squibb from 2016 to 2018 and Head of Worldwide Markets from 2015 to 2016.
people.quote: Mr. Murdo Gordon, age 59, became Executive Vice President, Global Commercial Operations, in 2018.

people.name: Jonathan P. Graham
people.title: Executive Vice President and General Counsel and Secretary
people.bio: Graham joined Amgen in 2015 as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary and became Executive Vice President in 2019. He previously served as Senior Vice President and General Counsel at Danaher and held a legal leadership role at General Electric.
people.quote: Mr. Jonathan P. Graham, age 65, became Executive Vice President and General Counsel and Secretary in 2019.

people.name: Peter H. Griffith
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Griffith joined Amgen in 2019 as Executive Vice President, Finance, and became Chief Financial Officer in 2020. He previously served as President of Sherwood Canyon Group and was a partner at EY, where his last position was Global Vice Chair, Corporate Development.
people.quote: Mr. Peter H. Griffith, age 67, became Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in 2020.

people.name: Nancy A. Grygiel
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Compliance Officer
people.bio: Grygiel joined Amgen in 2015 and served as Vice President, Compliance, from 2016 to 2020 before taking her current role. She previously served as Vice President, Compliance, Corporate & International, at Allergan.
people.quote: Ms. Nancy A. Grygiel, age 58, became Senior Vice President and Chief Compliance Officer in 2020.

people.name: Rachna Khosla
people.title: Senior Vice President, Business Development
people.bio: Khosla joined Amgen in 2013 and served as Vice President Business Development from 2018 to 2021 before taking her current role. She previously was a Director at Lazard responsible for healthcare mergers and acquisitions.
people.quote: Ms. Rachna Khosla, age 53, became Senior Vice President, Business Development, in 2021.

people.name: Derek Miller
people.title: Senior Vice President, Human Resources
people.bio: Miller joined Amgen in 2003 and has held human resources leadership roles of increasing responsibility. He served as Vice President, Human Resources, from 2018 to 2020 and Vice President, Global Total Rewards, from 2020 to 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Derek Miller, age 53, became Senior Vice President, Human Resources, in 2022.

people.name: David M. Reese
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer
people.bio: Reese became Amgen's inaugural Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer in 2023 after serving as Executive Vice President, Research and Development, from 2018 to 2023. Before joining Amgen, he was a cofounder, president, and chief medical officer of Translational Oncology Research International.
people.quote: Dr. David M. Reese, age 63, became the Company's inaugural Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer in 2023

people.name: Esteban Santos
people.title: Executive Vice President, Operations
people.bio: Santos joined Amgen in 2007 and served as Senior Vice President, Manufacturing, from 2013 to 2016 before taking his current role. He previously served as Site General Manager of Johnson & Johnson's Cordis operation in Puerto Rico and held management positions at General Electric.
people.quote: Mr. Esteban Santos, age 58, became Executive Vice President, Operations, in 2016.

people.name: Wanda M. Austin
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as President and Chief Executive Officer of The Aerospace Corporation from 2008 until her retirement in 2016. She was Interim President of the University of Southern California from 2018 to 2019.
people.quote: Wanda M. Austin has served as our director since 2017.

people.name: Robert A. Bradway
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Has served as Amgen's President since 2010, Chief Executive Officer since 2012, and Chairman since 2013. He joined Amgen in 2006 and served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer from 2007 to 2010.
people.quote: Robert A. Bradway has served as our director since 2011 and Chairman of the Board since 2013.

people.name: Michael V. Drake
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as President of the University of California from 2020 until his retirement in July 2025 and previously as President of The Ohio State University from 2014 to 2020. He has served as Distinguished Professor of Ophthalmology at the University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine since August 2025.
people.quote: Michael V. Drake has served as our director since 2022.

people.name: Brian J. Druker
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as President of the Oregon Health & Science University Knight Cancer Group since August 2025. He previously directed the OHSU Knight Cancer Institute from 2007 to 2024 and is a physician-scientist and professor of medicine.
people.quote: Brian J. Druker has served as our director since 2018.

people.name: Robert A. Eckert
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Has been an Operating Partner at FFL Partners, LLC since 2014 and Amgen's lead independent director since 2016. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Mattel from 2000 to 2011 and President and Chief Executive Officer of Kraft Foods from 1997 to 2000.
people.quote: Robert A. Eckert has served as our director since 2012 and our lead independent director since 2016.

people.name: Greg C. Garland
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Phillips 66 from 2012 to 2022 and as executive chairman from 2022 to 2024. He previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Chevron Phillips Chemical Company from 2008 to 2010.
people.quote: Greg C. Garland has served as our director since 2013.

people.name: Charles M. Holley, Jr.
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Walmart from 2010 to 2015 and as Executive Vice President in January 2016. He previously held other finance leadership roles at Walmart and spent more than ten years with Ernst & Young LLP.
people.quote: Charles M. Holley, Jr. has served as our director since 2017.
